Our cryptocurrency contract volume was higher in 2025 when compared to 2024, as a result of the continued broader acceptance of cryptocurrency products.

The increase in expense related to technology support services was primarily driven by higher third party services license fees and software license fees to support the ongoing Google Cloud transformation project.
Total clearing and transaction fees revenue in 2025 included $283.7 million of transaction fees attributable to the cash markets business, compared with $276.7 million in 2024.
The increase is primarily due to the increase in our fee structure, which went into effect on February 1, 2025.
Future capital expenditures for technology are anticipated as we continue to support our growth through increased system capacity, performance improvements, integration of acquired platforms.
